SASBDB entry SASDVW4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVW4/)

Publication: A conserved viral RNA fold enables nuclease resistance across kingdoms of life.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf840

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder; fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting
script test/fitting_tests/SASDVW4/ cites what it takes from the SASBDB record.

Files: fit1 (PyMOL model with one Mg2+ ion, CRYSOL chi2 1.779), unmodified.

Audit (2026-11-13, round 5): buffer and the 1 mM MgCl2 of this sample checked against the paper text (Methods p. 5, Data availability p. 14). Flag: model has 55 residues vs the 54 nt sample; temperature 20 C and wavelength 0.082 nm are SASBDB-only (paper defers to its Supplementary Table S1, not available).
Round 6 (2026-11-13): restored to test/fitting_tests. The paper fits the crystal structure (55 of 59 bases)
to the 54-nt data and the depositor's CRYSOL fit is this model, so the model is the paper's; 20 C and
0.082 nm are SASBDB's (the paper names none; the SASBDB record states them).
